programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ
programs.desc: Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Treasure Cruise; Pups Save Rocket Ryder
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger tricks people into sailing icy waters in search of an Antarctic treasure, but they all need to be rescued when they get stranded on shore; the pups need to rescue Ryder and Alex when they get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew; Pups Save an Ostrich
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties so they can appear better than the PAW Patrol; the Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Balloon Pups; Pups Save the Spider Spies
programs.desc: When giant balloons float away from a parade, it's up to the pups to save the pup balloons, the parade and Mayor Humdinger; the Turbot cousins try to spot a rare spider but get stuck in its web.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Hum-Sprayer; Pups Save the Hot Springs
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger makes a mess when he steals paint from Rubble's cousin Mix; two mountain goats cause trouble at adventure bay's hot springs.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save an Antarctic Martian; Pups Save the Maze Explorers
programs.desc: Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars; Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze.
